name: Myling
notes: CR 1. Spirit of abandoned child. Demands burial rites. Campaign-custom.
gm_notes: Session 3 forest. Spirit of an abandoned or unmourned child. Clings to living creatures demanding burial rites -- the creature grapples and does psychic damage while clinging. DC 12 Religion check to lay to rest without combat. Laid to rest: the creature dissolves peacefully; players gain advantage on next Wisdom save.
